name.description: The resource ID of the environment group.
name.rationale: It sets the identifier of the environment group and does not have any direct security impact.

org_id.description: The Apigee Organization associated with the environment group.
org_id.rationale: It sets the organization association and does not have any direct security impact.

hostnames.description: Hostnames of the environment group, used for routing incoming API traffic.
hostnames.rationale: Without at least one hostname configured, API traffic cannot be routed to the environment group, rendering it non-functional and potentially exposing misconfigurations.
